questions.question_text: (Optional) Resumes for all key team members, not exceeding two pages per person, are to be attached.
questions.constraints: not exceeding two pages per person

questions.question_text: Three client references for comparable projects are to be provided using the table in Appendix B.
questions.constraints: three references, table in Appendix B

questions.question_text: The proposed project team structure and the role of each team member are to be described.
(Desirable) Does your organization have an office in Alberta? (Yes/No)
Please describe at least two comparable projects completed in the last five years, including scope, duration and outcome.
The product roadmap for the next 24 months is to be attached.
Please describe how the electronic records management system scales to support peak loads and growth in the number of users.
Does the electronic records management system support single sign-on using SAML 2.0 or OpenID Connect? (Yes/No)
Describe how retention schedules are applied and how records are disposed of at the end of the retention period.
(Optional) Does the electronic records management system support legal holds that suspend disposal of selected records? (Yes/No)
Please describe your approach to migrating approximately two million existing documents, including metadata mapping.
Proponent to describe the OCR and full-text search capabilities, including supported languages.
Please describe how public requests for records are searched, reviewed and redacted.
Will any County records be stored, processed or accessed outside Canada? (Yes/No)
What are your recovery time and recovery point objectives, and when were they last tested?
Describe how you comply with the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (Alberta) and any other privacy legislation that applies to County records.
(Optional) How is County records encrypted at rest and in transit, and who holds the encryption keys?
Provide a work plan in tabular form showing milestones, deliverables, responsibilities and dates.
State the proposed implementation timeline from contract award to go-live.
List all subcontractors you intend to use and the portion of the work each will perform.
Describe your support model, including hours of coverage, escalation paths and target response times.
Describe your approach to migrating existing data, including cut-over and rollback.
Please confirm that your prices will be held for 120 days after the Closing Time. (Yes/No)
Provide hourly rates by role for change requests and additional services.
Complete the Pricing Schedule in Appendix C, showing all prices in Canadian dollars and excluding GST.
questions.constraints: Appendix C; Canadian dollars, excluding GST

questions.question_text: (Optional) Any annual price escalation proposed for the term of the contract is to be described.
Attach a current Workers' Compensation Board clearance letter.
The most recent SOC 2 Type II report is to be attached.
(Optional) How is County records encrypted at rest and in transit, and who holds the encryption keys?
The Proponent shall provide three client references for comparable projects using the table in Appendix B.
questions.constraints: three references, table in Appendix B

questions.question_text: The Proponent shall describe its support model, including hours of coverage, escalation paths and target response times.
